svg.text: Development of a Software Application for Analysis and Processing of DVB-S2 Receiver Output Stream

g.text: Source Data Stream Capture (Baseband / Demodulated Output)
Sync byte 0x47 • Fixed-length framing • PID multiplexing • Continuity Counter
ETSI TS 102 606 • Variable-length framing • Frag ID • IP/Ethernet network layer
ETSI EN 302 307 • 10-byte BBHeader • MATYPE / DFL / CRC-8 validation
Format Detection & Ingestion — Header synchronization voting • Magic byte detection • GSE payload heuristics
PID Demuxing • Continuity Counter (CC) Tracking • TEI Check • PUSI & Adaptation Field
PDU Framing • EtherType Protocol Demux • Frag ID Reassembly • Total Length Bounds
MATYPE Decoding • Data Field Length (DFL) Validation • SYNC/SYNCD Tracking • CRC-8
Normalizes Spatial Metrics Across Heterogeneous Window Partitions (w = 200 pkts / 3 PDUs / 50 frames)
Window byte throughput • Packet / frame counts • Temporal cadence • Statistical dispersion
Standardized spatial window metrics enabling cross-format rate profiling & timeline analysis
Preserves native semantics: PID Shannon entropy (TS) • Fragmentation ratio (GSE) • DFL / MATYPE (BBFrame)
* Preserves native protocol semantics with full fidelity — no artificial metric conflation
F1 – F7 ANALYTICS ENGINE (INDEPENDENT COOPERATIVE MODULES)
Deterministic Stream Integrity & ETSI TR 101 290 Indicators
Sync loss • TEI flags • CC discontinuities • CRC-8 validation • Bounds compliance
Multivariate spatial anomaly scoring with upper 5% bounded contamination threshold
PID Shannon entropy • Protocol demux distribution • Mode transitions • Modal DFL dispersion
Spatial byte offset profiling • Window rate variation • Temporal anomaly distribution
Bounded |Z| ≤ 20.0σ deviation scoring identifying root contributing metric features
Side-by-side compatible metric comparison guarded by strict semantic compatibility shield
Structured Analysis Report Generation & Telemetry Synthesis
Consolidates F1–F6 analytical findings into comprehensive technical summaries & audit trails
Next.js 15 + React 19 + TypeScript ⟷ Local REST API ⟷ Python Analysis Backend (FastAPI / Port 8080)
FastAPI runtime • Interactive stream ingestion & native parsing • Direct F1–F7 algorithm coordinator execution
Precompiled empirical telemetry datasets • Zero client-side recomputation • Resilient evaluation without live backend
• Tabulated stream integrity audit & health summary
• Structured human-readable technical review audit trail
• Terminal-friendly plain text summary for console inspect
• Safe for headless & legacy systems without GUI
• Self-contained report with zero external CDN dependencies
• Embedded CSS & interactive visual telemetry charts
• Fully portable report viewable in any modern web browser

svg.text: * MPEG-TS, GSE, and BBFrame are mutually exclusive alternative input formats — not sequential conversions.
